scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks gently with a group of disciples seated together on a sunlit stone terrace overlooking a peaceful landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jesus reassuring his listeners, reflecting the verse's call for their hearts not to be troubled and to believe in God and in him. The setting and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus smooths bedding in a sunlit stone house, with several welcoming rooms visible through open doorways.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus preparing a place in his Father’s house, with open rooms suggesting the many dwelling places described in John 14:2. It does not depict the house literally.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus opens his arms to welcome a joyful group of followers on a flower-lined path, with a sunlit dwelling and garden behind him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus welcoming his followers toward a prepared place, reflecting the verse's promise that he will come again and receive them to be with him. The garden and dwelling are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to attentive disciples beneath a tree and gestures toward a winding path through a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a winding path to evoke Jesus' words that his listeners know the way to the place where he is going.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Thomas sits with open hands as he speaks to Jesus, who listens calmly; other disciples watch in a warm stone room, with a winding path visible through the doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Thomas asking the Lord how they can know the way when they do not know where He is going. The room, listeners and visible path are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to an attentive man beneath a tree, gesturing toward a sunlit path winding through flowers and greenery to a distant city.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Jesus' words that he is the way, the truth, and the life, and that no one comes to the Father except through him. The path and distant light are visual metaphors, not a depiction of the verse's setting.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to attentive disciples beneath a tree in a sunlit landscape, with warm light falling over the gathering.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes Jesus' words about knowing him and knowing and having seen the Father; the light is an artistic suggestion, not a depiction of the Father.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Philip gestures earnestly toward Jesus as other disciples listen beneath a tree in a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Philip asking the Lord to show them the Father, as described in John 14:8; the setting and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with an open hand to Philip, who listens thoughtfully, while other disciples sit nearby in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Jesus speaking to Philip in John 14:9, where Jesus says that the one who has seen him has seen the Father.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures as he speaks to attentive listeners seated around him in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking with listeners evokes his question about believing that he is in the Father and the Father is in him, and his words about the Father dwelling in him and doing his works.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits with open hands, speaking to attentive disciples in a warmly sunlit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays Jesus inviting his listeners to believe his words about the Father and, if not, to believe because of the works themselves. The setting and sunlight are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to gathered disciples beneath a tree while a man helps another rise and people share food along a sunlit village path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Jesus' promise that the one believing in him will do his works and greater works, because he is going to the Father. The acts of care and light in the sky are artistic suggestions, not events specified in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus extends a hand toward a follower with open hands as others gather around him in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggests asking in Jesus' name and his response, with warm light evoking the Father's glory in the Son. It does not depict a specific incident described in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits among disciples in a warmly lit room, extending a hand toward a disciple who gestures with open hands.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation evokes Jesus' promise that if his disciples ask him anything in his name, he will do it; the verse does not describe this particular scene.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with a small group of attentive disciples in a sunlit stone courtyard; one disciple holds a hand over his heart.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus teaching disciples, suggesting the relationship between love for him and keeping his commandments in John 14:15. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree, raising one hand toward a sunlit sky as disciples gather around and listen in a hilly landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene pictures Jesus speaking of asking the Father to give another Helper to be with his listeners for the age. The warm light is a poetic suggestion of abiding presence, not a literal depiction of the Helper.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A group listens to a seated teacher in a sunlit stone courtyard while townspeople pass along the street beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering and its warm light suggest the Spirit of truth abiding with those who know Him, while others pass by absorbed in their activities. The setting and light are artistic choices, not a literal depiction of the Spirit or a historical scene specified by the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus extends a welcoming hand toward a group of adult disciples in a sunlit stone courtyard, beneath olive branches.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus coming to his disciples conveys the verse's promise that he will not leave them as orphans; it is not a literal reconstruction.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands among attentive followers in a sunlit garden, while people walk away along a distant village path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus with followers who see him, with morning light and new growth suggesting his promise that because he lives they also will live; the garden and distant passersby are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands among attentive disciples in a sunlit landscape, gesturing warmly as they look toward him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene uses shared golden light and the disciples' attentive faces to suggest the verse's promise that they will know Jesus is in the Father, they are in him, and he is in them.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with open hands beside a man and woman sharing bread in a sunlit village courtyard; a closed scroll rests nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects the sharing of bread and Jesus' warm presence with the verse's words about keeping his commandments, loving him, being loved by the Father and by Jesus, and Jesus showing himself. It does not portray a specified historical event.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A disciple gestures toward Jesus as he speaks, while others listen in a sunlit room; a town is visible outside.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Judas, not Iscariot, asking Jesus why He is about to reveal Himself to the disciples and not to the world. The room, gestures and view of the town are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a sunlit table in a stone home while an attentive woman looks up at him beside the open doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the welcome and shared home in Jesus' promise that those who love him and keep his word will be loved by his Father, and that they will come and make a home with them.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard while a man at the side turns away with folded arms.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflects Jesus' words about not keeping his words and the word heard coming from the Father who sent him; the courtyard and listeners are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to attentive disciples gathered around him in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking while present with his listeners, reflecting John 14:25; the room and details are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warmly lit room, disciples gather thoughtfully while a dreamlike remembrance above them shows Jesus teaching.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting the Holy Spirit teaching the disciples and bringing Jesus’ words to their remembrance, as described in John 14:26. The light and remembered scene are visual metaphors.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits among attentive disciples in a warmly lit room, extending an open hand as a storm blows beyond the doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jesus giving his peace and reassuring troubled hearts in John 14:27; the room and storm are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to attentive disciples in a warm room, gesturing toward an open doorway filled with sunlight.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking to his listeners evokes his words about going to the Father and coming to them, with the doorway suggesting departure and hope.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with an open hand to attentive disciples gathered in a warmly lit room, with a golden sky visible through an open doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus telling his listeners beforehand, reflecting the verse’s connection between what he has said, what will happen, and their believing. The setting and dawn are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks calmly to attentive disciples in a warmly lit room, while an indistinct shadow approaches along the street outside the open door.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking with his listeners as the coming ruler of the world is suggested by a shadow outside. The untouched lamplight around Jesus suggests the verse's statement that the ruler has nothing in him.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward an open doorway while disciples rise around him in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene depicts Jesus inviting his disciples to rise and leave, suggesting the loving obedience to the Father expressed in John 14:31.
